note: Income statement flow charts built from each company's own filed results. Profitable quarters flow revenue into profit and cost; loss-making quarters show the net loss funding the gap.

notes: Loss-making, so this chart uses the loss layout: revenue plus the net loss fund every cost line. Gross profit $1,696M + net loss $626M = $2,322M of charges, which balances exactly.

The operating loss is only $49M. The net loss is $626M — the gap is financing. Interest and other netted to $515M (gross interest expense $640M against $125M other income), more than ten times the operating loss.
Technology & infrastructure alone is $1,507M, 59% of revenue, which is what turns a 66% gross margin into an operating loss.
Revenue backlog was roughly $104B at June 30, with more than $25B of net new commitments added in early Q3. Full-year 2026 guidance is $12.4-13.2B revenue against $35-39B of capex.

items.source: Micron Form 8-K, Q4 FY26 press release
notes: Core Data Center is the swing factor: $18.0B, up 1,041% Y/Y, now a third of revenue.
Cost of revenue is only $7.2B of $54.2B — an 87% gross margin, extraordinary for a memory maker and the clearest sign of where pricing sits in this cycle.
Operating expenses total $3.3B, just 6% of revenue, so almost all gross profit drops to operating profit.
Full fiscal year 2026: $133.19B revenue and $84.97B net income. Q1 FY27 guidance is ~$61.5B ± $1.5B.
